Picks tonight's rota and sends the first shift to their posts (needs 3+ grown-ups who live here, within 60 tiles).
The first shift goes to bed, the second is woken and goes out.
Dawn: the watch comes in (shared moments, the morning line).
Spawns a zombie 7 tiles east of a watcher on a post: they should see it and raise the Horn by name.
Places the family that joined last at its house (for a family that joined out of range).
Households, families joined, nights watched, sightings, the place's draw and tonight's watch phase.
Milk, eggs, plantings, harvests and animal gifts so far.
Runs the adoption naming prompt on the nearest walking child within 10 tiles.  Needs the People First engine build and the People First: Engine mod (on a stock build nothing happens).
Runs the newborn naming prompt on the nearest baby within 10 tiles, as if you were its mother.  Needs the engine build.
Runs the wake-up signal as if you just woke at home (it still needs someone who cares, and a home within 30 tiles).
So you can ask them to come live with you.
Runs the natural spawn once, ignoring the population cap.  Kinds: 0 hunters, 1 family on the move, 2 settled family.
A family on the move, a few tiles away, so you can watch them.
Home evenings, people living with you, bands that joined you, bands alive, natural spawns.
Opens the Keep lab: the meeting now, quarrels, dissent, laws, the tithe, the rest day, a lord and heir, exile, stats.
Opens the v0.7 lab: the household roll, leaving, days passing at home, raids while you're gone, coming home, trouble for a band on the road, a child losing a parent, the tense evening.
effect.title: Home lab (v0.4-0.6)
